note: Build-time aggregate of every public/cards/*.json wrapper (card + inclusion proof), keyed by full sha256. Since csoai.cards-bundle/0.2 it is split so that no file nears Cloudflare Pages' 25 MiB per-file cap. `cards` here holds only the wrappers whose sha256 root.json lists (cards_scope "root"), so a reader that looks up a hash on the current root (/api/xrpl, /api/proof) needs ONE fetch. Every wrapper on disk, the root's included, sits in exactly one shard: the shard named by the first hex character of its sha256 (shards.files[].path). A reader that needs every wrapper reads this file and all listed shards and checks each shard's card_count, as_of and merkle_root against this index. Copies bytes that already exist under /cards/ and /proofs/; signs nothing, measures nothing. Regenerated in build:client, so it is consistent with the root.json shipped in the same build.
